content: वृषः .²1 A bull; असंपदस्तस्य वृषेण गच्छतः <ls>Ku. 5. 80</ls>; <ls>Me. 54</ls>; <ls>R. 2. 35</ls>; <ls>Ms. 9. 123</ls>. .²2 The sign {%Taurus%} of the zodiac. .²3 The chief or best of a class, the best of its kind; (often at the end of <ab>comp.</ab>); मुनिवृषः, कपिवृषः <ab>&c.</ab> .²4 The god of love. .²5 A strong or athletic man. .²6 A lustful man, a man of one of the four classes into which men are divided in erotic works; बहुगुणबहुबन्धः शीघ्रकामो नताङ्गः . सकलरुचिरदेहः सत्यवादी वृषो ना .. <ls>Ratimañjarī 37</ls>. .²7 An enemy, adversary. .²8 A rat. .²9 The bull of Śiva. .²10 Morality, justice; justice personified; वृषो हि भगवान् धर्मः <ls>Ms. 8. 16</ls>. .²11 Virtue, a pious or meritorious act; न सद्गतिः स्याद् वृषवर्जितानां <ls>Kīr. K. 9. 62</ls> (where वृष means a ‘bull’ also). .²12 <ab>N.</ab> of Karṇa. .²13 <ab>N.</ab> of Viṣṇu. .²14 <ab>N.</ab> of a particular drug. .²15 The principal die .²16 Water. .²17 A particular form of a temple. .²18 Ground suitable for the foundation of a house. .²19 A male, any male animal. .{@-षम्@} .²1 A peacockʼs plumage. .²2 A womanʼs apartment.
